text_en: After these things God tested Abraham. He said to him, “Abraham! ” And he said, “Here I am. ”
text_cn: 这些事以后，天主试探亚巴郎说：“亚巴郎！”他答说：“我在这里。”

text_en: He said, “Take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains that I shall show you. ”
text_cn: 天主说：“带你心爱的独生子依撒格往摩黎雅地方去，在我所要指给你的一座山上，将他献为全燔祭。”

text_en: So Abraham rose early in the morning, saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and his son Isaac; he cut the wood for the burnt offering, and set out and went to the place in the distance that God had shown him.
text_cn: 亚巴郎次日清早起来，备好驴，带了两个仆人和自己的儿子依撒格，劈好为全燔祭用的木柴，就起身往天主指给他的地方去了。

text_en: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place far away.
text_cn: 第三天，亚巴郎举目远远看见了那个地方，

text_en: Then Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey; the boy and I will go over there; we will worship, and then we will come back to you. ”
text_cn: 就对仆人说：“你们同驴在这里等候，我和孩子要到那边去朝拜，以后就回到你们这里来。”

text_en: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.
text_cn: 亚巴郎将为全燔祭用的木柴，放在儿子依撒格的肩上，自己手中拿着刀和火，两人一同前行。

text_en: Isaac said to his father Abraham, “Father! ” And he said, “Here I am, my son. ” He said, “The fire and the wood are here, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering? ”
text_cn: 路上依撒格对父亲亚巴郎说：“阿爸！”他答说：“我儿，我在这里。”依撒格说：“看，这里有火有柴，但是哪里有作全燔祭的羔羊？”

text_en: Abraham said, “God himself will provide the lamb for a burnt offering, my son. ” So the two of them walked on together.
text_cn: 亚巴郎答说：“我儿！天主自会照料作全燔祭的羔羊。”于是二人再继续一同前行。

text_en: When they came to the place that God had shown him, Abraham built an altar there and laid the wood in order. He bound his son Isaac, and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
text_cn: 当他们到了天主指给他的地方，亚巴郎便在那里筑了一座祭坛，摆好木柴，将儿子依撒格捆好，放在祭坛上的木柴上。

text_en: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to kill his son.
text_cn: 亚巴郎正伸手举刀要宰献自己的儿子时，

text_en: But the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven, and said, “Abraham, Abraham! ” And he said, “Here I am. ”
text_cn: 上主的使者从天上对他喊说：“亚巴郎！亚巴郎！”他答说：“我在这里。”

text_en: He said, “Do not lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me. ”
text_cn: 使者说：“不可在这孩子身上下手，不要伤害他！我现在知道你实在敬畏天主，因为你为了我竟连你的独生子也不顾惜。”

text_en: And Abraham looked up and saw a ram, caught in a thicket by its horns. Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering instead of his son.
text_cn: 亚巴郎举目一望，见有一只公绵羊，两角缠在灌木中，遂前去取了那只公绵羊，代替自己的儿子，献为全燔祭。

text_en: So Abraham called that place “The Lord will provide”; as it is said to this day, “On the mount of the Lord it shall be provided. ”
text_cn: 亚巴郎给那地方起名叫“上主自会照料”。直到今日人还说：“在山上，上主自会照料。”

text_en: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven,
text_cn: 上主的使者由天上又呼唤亚巴郎说：

text_en: and said, “By myself I have sworn, says the Lord : Because you have done this, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
text_cn: “我指自己起誓，──上主的断语，──因为你作了这事，没有顾惜你的独生子，

text_en: I will indeed bless you, and I will make your offspring as numerous as the stars of heaven and as the sand that is on the seashore. And your offspring shall possess the gate of their enemies,
text_cn: 我必多多祝福你，使你的后裔繁多，如天上的星辰，如海边的沙粒。你的后裔必占领他们仇敌的城门；

text_en: and by your offspring shall all the nations of the earth gain blessing for themselves, because you have obeyed my voice. ”
text_cn: 地上万民要因你的后裔蒙受祝福，因为你听从了我的话。”

text_en: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they arose and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham lived at Beer-sheba.
text_cn: 亚巴郎回到自己仆人那里，一同起身回了贝尔舍巴，遂住在贝尔舍巴。

text_en: Now after these things it was told Abraham, “Milcah also has borne children, to your brother Nahor:
text_cn: 这些事以后，有人告诉亚巴郎说：“米耳加也给你的兄弟纳曷尔生了儿子：

text_en: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
text_cn: 长子伍兹，他的弟弟步次、阿兰的父亲刻慕耳、

text_en: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel. ”
text_cn: 革色得、哈左、丕耳达士、依德拉夫和贝突耳：──

text_en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
text_cn: 贝突耳生了黎贝加，──这八人都是米耳加给亚巴郎的兄弟纳曷尔生的儿子。

text_en: Moreover, his concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
text_cn: 此外他的妾，名叫勒乌玛的，给他生了特巴黑、加罕、塔哈士和玛阿加。”
